brief_zh: 阳台上的小植物口渴了也不会说话。请你设计一个浇水提醒，让家里人记得按时给它喝水！
brief_en: The little plants on the balcony can't say when they are thirsty. Can you make a reminder so everyone remembers to water them?

info_hints.zh: 摸一摸土，干的还是湿的？
info_hints.en: Touch the soil. Is it dry or wet?

info_hints.zh: 问问家人：多久浇一次水？
info_hints.en: Ask your family: how often do we water it?

info_hints.zh: 看看叶子，有没有垂下来？
info_hints.en: Look at the leaves. Are they drooping?

plan_rubric.zh: 提醒能让人看见或听见
plan_rubric.en: people can see or hear the reminder
it goes somewhere easy to notice

reflection_prompts.en: What will you change next time?

brief_zh: 垃圾也要回到自己的家！请你给家里的垃圾桶做分类标签，让大家一看就知道什么垃圾放哪里。
brief_en: Trash needs to go to the right home too! Make labels for the bins at home so everyone knows where each kind of trash goes.

info_hints.en: How many bins do we have at home?

info_hints.zh: 问问大人：果皮放哪里？瓶子放哪里？
info_hints.en: Ask a grown-up: where do fruit peels go? Bottles?

info_hints.zh: 拍一拍小区里的分类垃圾桶
info_hints.en: Take a photo of the sorting bins outside

plan_rubric.zh: 用图画让不识字的人也看懂

plan_rubric.en: colors or shapes tell them apart

result_rubric.en: easy to see what goes where

reflection_prompts.en: What will you change next time?

brief_zh: 今天你是小店长！开一天家庭小卖部：选好要卖的东西，给它们定价钱，再画一张海报请家人来买。
brief_en: Today you are the shop boss! Run a family shop for a day: pick things to sell, give them prices, and draw a poster to invite your family.

info_hints.zh: 家里有什么可以"卖"的玩具或零食？
info_hints.en: What toys or snacks could you "sell"?

info_hints.zh: 问问家人：超市里一个苹果多少钱？
info_hints.en: Ask your family: how much is an apple at the store?

info_hints.zh: 看看商店的海报上都有什么
info_hints.en: Look at a shop poster. What is on it?

result_rubric.en: there are price tags and a poster
your family came to buy something

reflection_prompts.en: What will you change next time?

brief_zh: 早上吃什么呢？请你为家人设计一份早餐菜单，想一想每个人喜欢吃什么，还要吃得健康哦！
brief_en: What's for breakfast? Design a breakfast menu for your family. Think about what everyone likes, and make it healthy too!

info_hints.zh: 问问每个家人最爱吃什么早餐
info_hints.en: Ask each person their favorite breakfast
Look inside the fridge. What is there?

info_hints.zh: 问问小星：什么食物让我们有力气？
info_hints.en: Ask Xiaoxing: which foods give us energy?

result_rubric.zh: 真的吃了一顿菜单上的早餐
result_rubric.en: you really ate a breakfast from it

reflection_prompts.en: What will you change next time?

brief_zh: 一张薄薄的纸，能托住一本书吗？请你用纸搭一座桥，架在两堆书中间，让桥上能放一本书不塌！
brief_en: Can thin paper hold up a book? Build a paper bridge between two piles of books, strong enough to hold one book without falling!

info_hints.zh: 试一试：平平的纸和折过的纸，哪个更结实？
info_hints.en: Try it: is flat paper or folded paper stronger?

info_hints.zh: 看看真的桥，下面是什么样子？
info_hints.en: Look at a real bridge. What is underneath?

info_hints.zh: 问问家人：怎样让纸变硬？
info_hints.en: Ask your family: how can paper get stiffer?

plan_rubric.zh: 想了让纸变结实的办法
plan_rubric.en: has an idea to make paper stronger

result_rubric.en: you tested it with a book

result_rubric.zh: 桥撑住了，或者找到了原因
result_rubric.en: it held, or you found out why not

reflection_prompts.en: What will you change next time?

brief_zh: 我们要去郊游啦！请你帮全家规划要带的东西，想一想天气、吃的、玩的，做一张打包清单。
brief_en: We're going on a family trip! Plan what everyone should bring. Think about the weather, food and fun, then make a packing list.

understand_check.en: the family goes on a trip

info_hints.zh: 问问家人：我们去哪里？要去多久？
info_hints.en: Ask your family: where are we going? For how long?

info_hints.zh: 看看窗外，今天天气怎么样？
info_hints.en: Look outside. What is the weather like?

info_hints.zh: 问问小星：出门玩可能需要什么？
info_hints.en: Ask Xiaoxing: what might we need on a trip?

plan_rubric.en: thinks about everyone in the family

result_rubric.en: the bag was packed using the list

reflection_prompts.en: What will you change next time?
